result.title: Target-Part Preference Optimization for Part-Aware 3D Generation
result.summary: Part-aware 3D generation requires not only globally plausible objects but also complete, well-separated semantic parts, yet high-quality part decompositions remain too scarce to support large-scale supervised fine-tuning. We study whether preference fine-tuning based on Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) can adapt a pretrained part-aware generator from limited part-annotated data without architectural changes. We rank candidates generated with different random seeds against ground-truth (GT) geometric metrics, and select the (object, target-part) examples with the largest across-seed quality gap. Each selected example stores a seed pair whose two flow trajectories share one clean GT compositional latent and differ only in Gaussian noise. We derive a reference-relative target-block preference loss from FlowDPO that compares the two trajectories against a frozen reference model. GT flow-matching losses on the target block and complete part set provide absolute supervision, while only the diffusion transformer (DiT) is updated. Human-ranked controls test an alternative ordering source, and synthetic cropping provides controlled loser targets that are incomplete by construction. Among the three training-set scales, the medium-scale setting gives the strongest result on held-out Objaverse and outperforms both the pretrained generator and the reported direct supervised fine-tuning baseline on the multi-part aggregate. Further analysis shows sensitivity to pair ordering, target-part coverage, and the balance between pairwise and GT supervision. Cross-dataset experiments show less consistent gains under distribution shift.

AI.brief_summary: 论文研究能否在不改结构的前提下，用基于 DPO 的偏好微调把预训练部件感知 3D 生成器适配到少量部件标注数据：按多种子生成的质量差距挑选（物体，目标部件）样本，构造共享同一 GT 组合 latent、仅高斯噪声不同的轨迹对，结合目标块上的 GT flow-matching 监督，只更新 DiT。
AI.relevance_reason: 其偏好对只在高斯噪声上不同、且把监督定位到目标 latent 块，可能为 LVR 中 latent 推理轨迹的局部贡献分配与偏好式轨迹训练提供可核查线索，但属 3D 生成场景，迁移性需自行判断。
